theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [HopfAlgebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (ι : BialgHom k A H) (_hι : Function.Injective ι) {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [Module A M] [IsScalarTower k A M] [Module.Finite A M] (μ : M →ₗ[k] TensorProduct k M H) (_hcoassoc : ∀ m : M, TensorProduct.assoc k M H H ((TensorProduct.map μ (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[k] H)) (μ m)) = (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[k] M) (Coalgebra.comul (R := k))) (μ m)) (_hcounit : ∀ m : M, TensorProduct.rid k M ((TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[k] M) (Coalgebra.counit (R := k))) (μ m)) = m) (_hcompat : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), let d := Coalgebra.Repr.arbitrary k a; μ (a • m) = ∑ i ∈ d.index, TensorProduct.map ((Algebra.lsmul k k M) (d.left i)) (LinearMap.mulLeft k (ι (d.right i))) (μ m)), Module.Projective A M
theorems.natural_summary: Uses finite presentation, coaction-twist invariance and tensor descent to apply the accepted coideal dichotomy and determinantal projectivity criterion.
